notes: The B.A. has three concentrations; the checker encodes only what they share. GREEK concentration: 18 credits of GREE at 2000+, at least 6 credits LATI, 12 credits related courses including HIEU 2031 and CLAS 2010 or 2020 (other related: more Greek/Latin or classical art, history, religion approved by the DUS). LATIN concentration: 18 credits of LATI at 2000+ including at least one 4000+ course (not LATI 4993), at least 6 credits GREE, 12 credits related including HIEU 2041 and CLAS 2010 or 2020. GREEK & LATIN concentration: GREE 2010-2020 and LATI 2010-2020 (or equivalent), plus 18 credits of Greek and Latin above that level including at least two Greek courses at 3000+ or one Latin course at 4000+ (as worded on the department page), plus CLAS 2010 or 2020 and HIEU 2031 or 2041. All courses at UVA or approved study abroad; AP credit does not count; C- or better required. DMP needs 3.4 GPA. totalCredits 36 is approximate (Greek/Latin concentrations: 18+6+12). 2026-27 Record page could not be loaded.

declaration.notes: Cumulative UVA GPA of at least 3.400. IMP Board deadlines: November 15 (fall hearing) and April 17 (spring). Then file a Declaration of Major form approved by a sponsor.
